question_english: Which of the following best defines the primary distinction between educational administration and educational management in the context of school governance?
options_english: Administration focuses on policy formulation and goal setting, whereas management handles operational execution.
Administration focuses on operational execution of tasks, whereas management formulates long-term policies.
Administration focuses on financial resource allocation, whereas management handles pedagogical leadership.
Administration focuses on transformational leadership, whereas management relies on situational frameworks.
explanation_english: The correct answer is that administration focuses on policy formulation and goal setting, whereas management handles operational execution. Educational administration operates at a broad structural level, dealing with high-level policy formulation, establishing organizational goals, and defining overall governance frameworks. Conversely, educational management functions on an operational basis, focusing on executing these established policies, managing daily physical and human resources, directing teaching staff, and ensuring smooth routine implementation to achieve specific institutional objectives successfully.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रशासन नीति निर्माण और लक्ष्य निर्धारण पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है, जबकि प्रबंधन संचालनात्मक कार्यान्वयन को संभालता है। शैक्षिक प्रशासन व्यापक संरचनात्मक स्तर पर कार्य करता है, उच्च-स्तरीय नीति निर्माण, संगठनात्मक लक्ष्यों की स्थापना, और समग्र शासन ढांचे को परिभाषित करने से संबंधित होता है। इसके विपरीत, शैक्षिक प्रबंधन संचालनात्मक आधार पर कार्य करता है, स्थापित नीतियों को लागू करने, दैनिक भौतिक और मानव संसाधनों का प्रबंधन करने, शिक्षण स्टाफ का निर्देशन करने, और विशिष्ट संस्थागत उद्देश्यों को सफलतापूर्वक प्राप्त करने के लिए सुचारू दिनचर्या कार्यान्वयन सुनिश्चित करने पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Administration focuses on policy formulation

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Educational administration operates at a broad structural level, dealing with high-level policy formulation, establishing organizational goals, and defining overall governance frameworks.

question_english: The term 'Span of Control' in school management refers to:
options_english: The geographical area from which a school draws its student population.
The financial limit up to which a Principal can sanction expenditure without higher approval.
The number of subordinates a supervisor or Principal can effectively manage and direct.

explanation_english: In organizational management, span of control defines the maximum number of direct subordinates that a manager, administrator, or school principal can directly supervise and direct effectively.            रूप से सीधे पर्यवेक्षण और निर्देशन कर सकता है। एक

question_english: Institutional planning at the school level is most effective when it adheres to the principle of:

Exclusive administrative planning by the Principal without external consultation.
Short-term reactive instructional planning based solely on monthly test results.
Grassroots planning involving teachers, parents, and community stakeholders.
explanation_english: Institutional planning is most effective and impactful when developed through a bottom-up, participatory approach. Democratic participation fosters strong community ownership, enhances shared accountability, and improves the overall sustainability and execution of school development initiatives.

question_english: In the context of decision-making by a school administrator, 'bounded rationality' indicates that:
options_english: The Principal consistently makes optimal decisions based on complete information and logic.
Decision-making is limited by available information, cognitive limits, and time constraints.
Decisions are made strictly through personal intuition and emotional responses without logic.
The decision-making authority of the Principal is strictly governed by the Management Committee.
explanation_english: Bounded rationality, a concept developed by Herbert Simon, asserts that administrative decision-makers cannot achieve perfect rationality due to unavoidable practical constraints. Administrators operate under incomplete information, cognitive processing limitations, and strict time pressures. Consequently, school administrators seek satisficing decisions—solutions that are sufficiently realistic, practical, and satisfactory under existing circumstances—rather than theoretically ideal or perfect choices.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सीमित तर्कशीलता, जो हर्बर्ट साइमोन द्वारा विकसित एक अवधारणा है, यह बताती है कि प्रशासनिक निर्णय लेने वाले पूर्ण तर्कशीलता प्राप्त नहीं कर सकते हैं क्योंकि अवश्यम्भावी व्यावहारिक सीमाएँ होती हैं। प्रशासक अधूरी जानकारी, संज्ञानात्मक प्रसंस्करण सीमाओं और कड़े समय के दबावों के तहत कार्य करते हैं। इसलिए, स्कूल प्रशासक संतोषजनक निर्णयों की खोज करते हैं—ऐसे समाधान जो मौजूदा परिस्थितियों के तहत पर्याप्त रूप से यथार्थवादी, व्यावहारिक और संतोषजनक होते हैं—न कि सैद्धांतिक रूप से आदर्श या पूर्ण विकल्प।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Decision-making is limited by available information, cognitive limits, and time constraints.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Bounded rationality, a concept developed by Herbert Simon, asserts that administrative decision-makers cannot achieve perfect rationality due to unavoidable practical constraints.

question_english: The 'Interactionist view' of conflict in organizational behavior suggests that:

options_english: Allowing the Principal to discard them independently in municipal waste.
Donating items directly to students without maintaining documentation.
Storing condemned furniture items indefinitely within school basements.
Auctioning or disposing after condemnation by a competent authority.

Under the General Financial Rules, unserviceable,
    obsolete, or damaged public property cannot
    be arbitrarily discarded or donated. Such
    items must undergo formal inspection and
    condemnation by a legally constituted competent
    authority. Following formal condemnation, the
    items are officially auctioned or disposed of
    according to standard government procedures,
    ensuring financial transparency and accounting
    compliance.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों के तहत, अनुपयोगी, पुरानी, या क्षतिग्रस्त सार्वजनिक संपत्ति को मनमाने ढंग से नहीं फेंका या दान नहीं किया जा सकता। ऐसी वस्तुओं को एक विधिवत रूप से गठित सक्षम प्राधिकरण द्वारा औपचारिक निरीक्षण और निंदा से गुजरना आवश्यक है। औपचारिक निंदा के बाद, वस्तुओं को आधिकारिक रूप से नीलाम या निपटान किया जाता है, जो वित्तीय पारदर्शिता और लेखांकन अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Auctioning or disposing after condemnation
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the General Financial Rules, unserviceable, obsolete, or damaged public property cannot be arbitrarily discarded or donated.

question_english:
Consider the following leadership styles based on the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership model:
       I. Directing
       II. Coaching
       III. Supporting
       IV. Delegating
       Which of the following aligns these styles correctly with the progressive readiness levels (from lowest readiness to highest readiness) of followers?
options_english: I, II, III, IV
IV, III, II, I
II, I, III, IV
I, III, II, IV
explanation_english: The Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership model aligns leadership behaviors with progressive follower readiness levels. For low readiness (unable and unwilling), leaders use Directing. As readiness increases (unable but willing), leaders shift to Coaching. Higher readiness (able but unwilling) warrants Supporting, while the highest readiness (able and willing) calls for Delegating, establishing a sequential progression.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। Hersey-Blanchard स्थिति नेतृत्व मॉडल नेतृत्व व्यवहारों को प्रगतिशील अनुयायी तत्परता स्तरों के साथ संरेखित करता है। निम्नतम तत्परता (असमर्थ और अनिच्छुक) के लिए, नेता निर्देशित करना उपयोग करते हैं। जैसे-जैसे तत्परता बढ़ती है (असमर्थ लेकिन इच्छुक), नेता कोचिंग की ओर बढ़ते हैं। उच्चतम तत्परता (समर्थ लेकिन अनिच्छुक) समर्थन की आवश्यकता होती है, जबकि उच्चतम तत्परता (समर्थ और इच्छुक) प्रतिनिधि बनाने की मांग करती है, जो एक अनुक्रमिक प्रगति स्थापित करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II, III, IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership model aligns leadership behaviors with progressive follower readiness levels. For low readiness (unable and unwilling), leaders use Directing. As readiness increases (unable but willing), leaders shift to Coaching. Higher readiness (able but unwilling) warrants Supporting, while the highest readiness (able and willing) calls for Delegating, establishing a sequential progression.
